overview.title: Payroll, bookkeeping and tax, handled by one local team.

services.title: Individual Tax Returns

covers.text: Starting at $300 for an individual return.

services.title: Financial & Planning Advice
services.summary: 401(k)s, HSAs, LLCs and what fits you.
services.text: With our numerous years of experience, we are well versed in what is best for you, from 401(k)s and LLCs to HSAs and much more.
services.lead: Decisions about retirement accounts, health savings and how you hold your business all land on the same tax return, so we look at them together rather than one at a time.

covers.title: Retirement accounts
covers.text: What a 401(k) means for you and how it sits alongside the rest of your finances.

covers.title: Health savings accounts
covers.text: How an HSA works and where it fits.

covers.title: How you hold your business
covers.text: Whether an LLC is the right structure for what you are doing.

covers.title: Year round access
covers.text: We are here outside of tax season, so you are not waiting until filing time to ask.

services.title: Bookkeeping

services.text: Weekly, monthly, quarterly, whatever your business needs. We post and reconcile all business bank accounts, loans, HUDs and assets, and close every month with a profit and loss statement.

services.imageAlt: The Liberty Hill Bookkeeping & Tax Services storefront on Main Street

covers.text: Weekly, monthly or quarterly, whatever your business needs.

services.title: Payroll

services.text: No matter your company's size, we run your payroll, pay in your federal and state taxes and handle contributions such as a 401(k).
services.lead: Payroll is run for companies of any size, with the federal and state tax paid in on your behalf and the quarterly and annual reports filed when they fall due.

covers.title: Running payroll
covers.text: Starting at $100 a month, with prices varying depending on company size.

covers.title: Quarterly reports
covers.text: 941 reports are $50 per quarter and TWC reports are $50 per quarter.

covers.title: Contributions

services.title: Corporate Tax Returns
services.text: Our team of tax specialists can handle it all. 1040s, 1120s, 1099s, you name it, we have you covered, and we use our expertise to get you the best possible scenario.

covers.title: The filing

covers.title: The payment

services.text: They are due annually. We file your business's Texas Franchise Return with the Texas Comptroller.

about.title: What we do is who we are
text: Howdy. Liberty Hill Bookkeeping & Tax Services is a team of payroll, bookkeeping and tax professionals. We specialize in small to medium sized businesses, and our goal is to empower business owners and entrepreneurs to better manage the financial components of their business with our services.

We have been proudly serving Liberty Hill and surrounding areas since our establishment in 2011. We pride ourselves on being locally owned and operated. Our community is why we have been able to grow to the scale that we have.

Liberty Hill Bookkeeping & Tax Services was founded on the mission to serve our local businesses and individuals. After over a decade of service to our community, we are proud to say that we are still locally owned and operated, by Teri Reeves.
Our mission is to give each and every client the peace of mind they deserve.
about.imageAlt: The Welcome to Liberty Hill, Texas mural

values.title: Accuracy Guarantee
values.text: We commit 110% to each and every client. We aim for accuracy on your taxes, bookkeeping and payroll.

values.title: Grow Your Bottom Line
values.text: Our tax professionals help grow your bottom line by identifying every available credit and deduction, while ensuring accuracy in expense reporting.

values.title: Specialized in Small Business
values.text: Our small business experts can handle anything you can throw at us. If it is something we have not seen before, we are going to figure it out.

values.title: Year-Round Help
values.text: We are available year round so you can focus on your business's future. We are here and ready to help with whatever needs you may have.

team.name: Teri Reeves
team.bio: Teri is the owner of the firm, which she opened in 2012. She discovered accounting in high school when she got her first job as a bookkeeper for a family friend, and what made her fall in love with accounting and tax work was the idea of helping people. She and her two children moved to Liberty Hill in 2006 and quickly realised they were home.

team.name: Emi McFeron
team.bio: Emi was born and raised in Texas and graduated high school here in Liberty Hill. She started with the firm in 2015, grew into her responsibilities and fell in love with the job and with working with the clients, who have truly become her extended family. She is now the manager of the corporate tax department.
team.imageAlt: Emi McFeron, Corporate Tax Department Manager

team.name: Sidney Barcuch
team.role: Account Executive, Special Projects & H.R. Manager
team.bio: Sidney oversees Special Projects, which covers LLCs, and Human Resources, and is also an Account Executive. She graduated from the University of Texas at Austin in the fall of 2021 with a Bachelor's degree in Human Dimensions of Organizations and a minor in Business Administration, and she enjoys problem solving and providing catered solutions to issues the firm and its clients may have.
team.imageAlt: Sidney Barcuch, Account Executive and Special Projects and H.R. Manager

team.name: Andrea Ogren
team.bio: Andrea does bookkeeping, runs payroll and prepares payroll and sales tax returns. She stepped in with very little experience in June of 2021 and has increased her speed, accuracy and knowledge in a very short time. She takes great pride in doing a job to the best of her ability with little or no mistakes.

team.name: Jessie Pritchett
team.bio: Jessie graduated from the University of Colorado, Colorado Springs in 2020 with a degree in History and an emphasis in elementary education, and spent three years teaching first grade before joining the team. She loves learning about your business and how she can help, and takes joy in helping you with your finances.

team.name: Liza Schnell
team.bio: Liza grew up in the Houston area and moved to Liberty Hill around 2012. She has worked in a variety of office roles, and bookkeeping and accounting have always interested her. She made a career of it in October of 2024 by joining the firm.

team.name: Jo Leen Simon
team.bio: Jo Leen joined the firm in 2025, bringing over 15 years of experience from a CPA firm in Austin where she specialized in office management, bookkeeping and tax preparation. That background gives her a strong foundation in helping individuals and small businesses stay financially organized and tax ready year round. She moved to Liberty Hill in 2020.

team.name: Josh Denning
team.bio: Josh joined the firm in 2025. He previously served as a General Manager for several businesses, where he focused on team development, operational efficiency and managing behind the scenes administrative functions. He holds both a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Arts in Theology. He enjoys building relationships, solving problems and helping businesses stay organized, compliant and financially informed.

team.name: Brandon Reeves
team.bio: Brandon comes from a background in retail and warehouse operations, where he developed strong organizational skills, attention to detail and a hands on approach. He applies that experience to supporting clients and keeping financial records accurate and organized.

team.name: Janetsa Hernandez
team.bio: Janetsa joined the firm in July 2026. She earned her Master of Social Work from Aurora University and is a licensed mental health therapist, and before that she worked as an administrative assistant at the Graduate Admissions Office at the University of Texas at Tyler. She helps clients navigate their work with the firm, and being bilingual she assists the firm's Spanish speaking clients.

facts.heading: About our prices
facts.text: The prices shown on our service pages are generally our starting prices, and they are not a comprehensive list. Should you choose to seek out services with us, please keep in mind that your invoiced amount may vary.

facts.heading: Sending us documents
facts.text: If you would like to upload source or tax documents before we speak, the contact form on our site takes them.

facts.heading: Se habla español
facts.text: Our site carries a Spanish page, and Janetsa Hernandez assists the firm's Spanish speaking clients.

facts.heading: Your information
facts.text: We will not share or sell your information, including the phone number you give for SMS consent, to any third parties, affiliates or partners under any circumstances. Our privacy policy took effect on July 10, 2024.

facts.heading: Text messages
facts.text: Clients may consent to text messages through our contact form, by verbal agreement, by email or in writing, and can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

facts.heading: Seeing and correcting what we hold
facts.text: On request we will tell you whether we hold your personal information and give you reasonable access to update it, once we have verified your identity. Email info@lhbts.com or send a written request to the office.

facts.heading: Equal service either way
facts.text: You have the right to receive equal service and pricing from us even if you exercise the privacy rights set out in our policy.

facts.heading: Removing your data
facts.text: We honour client requests to remove data such as personal, account and billing information, taking it out of our production databases and shredding it through a trusted disposal service.

facts.heading: How your information is kept safe
facts.text: We maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards against loss, alteration and unauthorised access, and anything we collect from third party sources stays confidential within the firm. No transmission over the internet is completely secure, so absolute security cannot be guaranteed.

facts.heading: The information we need from you
facts.text: Without the necessary information we cannot effectively provide our services, and a client who declines to provide it is still billed for the time spent on that client or project.

facts.heading: Where we work
facts.text: Liberty Hill and the surrounding areas, from our office at 925 Main Street, since 2011.

facts.heading: Hours of operation
facts.text: 9 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Friday. Holidays may affect these hours.
